title: Experience Enhanced Control with Our New Platform
summary: After a successful beta phase, our significantly upgraded platform is now fully launched, providing you with powerful new tools to manage your operations with greater ease and precision.

title: Ultimate File Control for Your Content
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded images and documents with intuitive new tools to manage, upload, and customize their display directly within your editor.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Smoother Workflow

title: Next-Level Team Collaboration
summary: Experience smoother, more intuitive real-time teamwork with significant enhancements that make working together effortless and more transparent.

title: Effortless Shared Item Discovery

title: Dynamic Views for Effortless Note Organization

title: Introducing Noeko's Flexible Hosting and Premium Tiers
